messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up: planning a small refapp called "Pathfinder" + a 9-min micro-tutorial for next Wed. Goals: ~250 repo views, 80 signups, 60 webinar RSVPs. Need owners for: blog + HN blurb, bench one-pager, 9-min demo script, RSVP + thank-you email, and inbound routing + SDR playbook. Who can take what?

ben: I9ll own the bench one-pager and chart. Plan: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, $/1k tokens, and a short callout comparing quantized (q4) vs fp16. Test setup: 512 tokens, batch=3, KV-cache warmed. Will keep the slide tiny.

meera: I9ll do RSVP flow + thank-you email + calendar add. Form fields: name, email, company_size (opt), job_title (opt), use_case (free-text). Add utm_source=pathfinder, utm_campaign=ref_launch. Routing: company_size>75 OR job_title contains "platform|infra" -> AE queue; else SDR nurture. Tag leads with "ref:pathfinder".

cody: I9ll draft the blog + HN blurb and three hero variants. Two angles: hands-on quickstart and bench-first reliability story. Will label drafts copy/a, copy/b, copy/c.

olivia: Also want a short contributor CTA (how to PR examples + good-first-issue label) and schedule community office hours 1 week post-launch. Add that in the blog.

launch-bot: Created ticket MK-9001: "Pathfinder refapp launch checklist" assigned to olivia, ben, meera, cody. Reminder set for 48h before launch.

ben: Bench ETA tomorrow EOD. Will post a tiny raw table + PNG to MK-9001. Example inline table (will expand in ticket):
```
model,p50_ms,p95_ms,$/1k
hosted-small,110,300,$0.40
dedicated-2gpu,72,180,$0.20
q4_0-quant,85,210,$0.12
```

meera: Routing detail: if job_title blank, try LinkedIn lookup in the Zap; if lookup fails, tag role:unknown. If registrant checks "interested in dedicated" add tag interest:dedicated and route to AE. I9ll post the Zap steps in MK-9001.

cody: A/B plan: run hero variants on the landing page for 72h, KPI CTR->RSVP >= 2.8%. After 72h, pick winner and push to paid socials.

olivia: Demo script constraints: keep demo <=9m. Outline: 60s setup, 90s long-context example, 90s embedding/search use-case, bench slide, 30s wrap. Slides limited to 4.

ben: Methods note for bench: 3 runs, median reported, 512 tokens, batch=3, kv-cache warmed, quant flag explicit. Transparency callout included on the one-pager.

meera: Confirmed. I9ll wire Zap -> CRM mapping and SDR playbook snippet (handle for AE handoffs) into MK-9001.

cody: Confirmed. I9ll upload copy drafts and hero images to the ticket by EOD.

olivia: Great. Scheduling a 20m prep sync Mon 09:00 PT to walk through slide, RSVP flow, and demo script. Please confirm ownership by EOD. :rocket:
